readings: Which RFI status groups, including signals with no `rfistat` as a separate group, have an average `modindex` above the average `modindex` of all signals with a nonmissing index? For each qualifying group, show the status, its average index, its average minus the overall signal average, and its average minus the unweighted mean of the qualifying groups’ averages. Exclude missing index values from every calculation and leave all values unrounded.

Which RFI status groups, including signals with no `rfistat` as a separate group, have an average `modindex` above the unweighted mean of all RFI status groups’ average indexes? For each qualifying group, show the status, its average index, its average minus that mean, and its average minus the unweighted mean of the qualifying groups’ averages. Exclude missing index values from every calculation and leave all values unrounded.
queries:
WITH indexed_signals AS (
    SELECT rfistat, modindex
    FROM signals
    WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg
    FROM indexed_signals
),
qualifying_groups AS (
    SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS group_avg
    FROM indexed_signals
    GROUP BY rfistat
    HAVING AVG(modindex) > (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall)
)
SELECT
    rfistat,
    group_avg,
    group_avg - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall) AS difference_from_overall,
    group_avg - (SELECT AVG(group_avg) FROM qualifying_groups) AS difference_from_qualifying_groups
FROM qualifying_groups

WITH status_averages AS (
    SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_index
    FROM signals
    WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY rfistat
),
overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_index) AS mean_index
    FROM status_averages
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.avg_index, om.mean_index
    FROM status_averages AS sa
    CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om
    WHERE sa.avg_index > om.mean_index
)
SELECT
    rfistat AS status,
    avg_index,
    avg_index - mean_index AS difference_from_all_groups,
    avg_index - (SELECT AVG(avg_index) FROM qualifying) AS difference_from_qualifying_groups
FROM qualifying
